Attachment.name: theme

Attachment.name: name

Attachment.name: size
Attachment.description: Human size shown beside the name, for example "1.2 MB" (default: "1.2 MB")

Attachment.name: status

Attachment.name: thumbnail

ChatHistory.name: theme
ChatHistory.description: Palette override. Defaults to the nearest ThemeProvider.

ChatHistory.name: threads
ChatHistory.type: { id: string, title: string, preview?: string, time: string | Date, pinned?: boolean, unread?: boolean }[]
ChatHistory.description: Threads to list; `time` is an ISO string or a Date (default: CHATHIST_THREADS)

ChatHistory.name: activeId
ChatHistory.description: Controlled selection; leave undefined and the list keeps its own

ChatHistory.name: onSelect
ChatHistory.description: Fires when a row is picked

ChatHistory.name: onNew
ChatHistory.description: Shows the new-thread button in the header and fires when it is pressed

ChatHistory.name: onRename
ChatHistory.description: Enables Rename in the row menu; the new name is typed inline

ChatHistory.name: onDelete
ChatHistory.description: Enables Delete in the row menu

ChatHistory.name: onPin
ChatHistory.description: Enables Pin / Unpin in the row menu

ChatHistory.name: search
ChatHistory.description: Shows a search field that filters titles and previews (default: true)

ChatHistory.name: groupBy
ChatHistory.description: Group rows under Pinned, Today, Yesterday and Earlier headings, or list them flat (default: "day")

ChatHistory.name: width
ChatHistory.description: Width of the list in px (default: 280)

ChatHistory.name: height
ChatHistory.description: Height of the list in px; content scrolls inside it (default: 420)

ChatInput.name: theme
ChatInput.description: Palette override. Defaults to the nearest ThemeProvider.

ChatInput.name: value
ChatInput.description: Controlled text; leave undefined and the field keeps its own state

ChatInput.name: onChange
ChatInput.description: Fires on every edit, and with "" after a send

ChatInput.name: onSubmit

ChatInput.name: placeholder

ChatInput.name: suggestions
ChatInput.description: Prompt chips above the field; [] hides the row (default: CHATIN_SUGGESTIONS)

ChatInput.name: onSuggestion
ChatInput.description: Fires when a chip is picked; without it the chip fills the field

ChatInput.name: attachments
ChatInput.type: { id: string, name: string, kind?: string }[]

ChatInput.name: onAttach
ChatInput.description: Shows the attach button and fires when it is pressed

ChatInput.name: onRemoveAttachment
ChatInput.description: Fires from an attachment chip's remove control

ChatInput.name: models
ChatInput.description: Choices in the model pill; [] hides the pill (default: CHATIN_MODELS)

ChatInput.name: model
ChatInput.description: Controlled model id; leave undefined and the pill keeps its own state

ChatInput.name: onModelChange
ChatInput.description: Fires when a model is picked

ChatInput.name: streaming
ChatInput.description: Turns the send button into Stop (default: false)

ChatInput.name: onVoice
ChatInput.description: Shows the mic button and fires when it is pressed

ChatInput.name: disabled
ChatInput.description: Disables the field and every control (default: false)

ChatInput.name: maxRows

Conversation.name: theme
Conversation.description: Palette override. Defaults to the nearest ThemeProvider.

Conversation.name: messages
Conversation.type: { id: string, role: "user" | "agent" | "system", text?: string, time?: string, status?: string, sources?: object[], actions?: object[], streaming?: boolean, name?: string }[]
Conversation.description: Turns in order; every field is passed on to Message (default: CONV_MESSAGES)

Conversation.name: renderMessage
Conversation.description: Replaces the default Message for a turn

Conversation.name: children
Conversation.description: Turns rendered instead of `messages`, for fully custom content

Conversation.name: autoScroll
Conversation.description: Follow new content while the reader is at the bottom; scrolling up pauses it and shows a jump pill (default: true)

Conversation.name: jumpLabel
Conversation.description: Text of the jump pill (default: "Jump to latest")

Conversation.name: typing
Conversation.description: Shows the agent's thinking indicator after the last turn (default: false)

Conversation.name: height
Conversation.description: Height of the log in px (default: 420)

Conversation.name: frame
Conversation.description: Draw a hairline border and rounded corners around the log (default: true)

Conversation.name: emptyState
Conversation.description: Shown when there are no turns; the default invites the first question

Conversation.name: compact
Conversation.description: Passed on to every Message (default: false)

DocumentAgent.name: theme
DocumentAgent.description: Palette override. Defaults to the nearest ThemeProvider.

DocumentAgent.name: title
DocumentAgent.description: Document name shown in the header (default: "Refund policy · runbook")

DocumentAgent.name: agentName
DocumentAgent.description: Name of the agent proposing the edits (default: "Alpha")

DocumentAgent.name: edits
DocumentAgent.type: { id: string, blockId: string, kind: "replace" | "insert" | "delete", text?: string, reason?: string }[]
DocumentAgent.description: Suggested edits; insert places a new block after blockId (default: DOCAGENT_EDITS)

DocumentAgent.name: autoplay
DocumentAgent.description: Edits arrive one by one every `stepMs`; false shows them all at once with no timers (default: true)

DocumentAgent.name: onAccept
DocumentAgent.description: Fires when one edit is accepted

DocumentAgent.name: onReject
DocumentAgent.description: Fires when one edit is rejected

DocumentAgent.name: onAcceptAll
DocumentAgent.description: Fires when every pending edit is accepted from the header

Marker.name: theme
Marker.description: Palette override. Defaults to the nearest ThemeProvider.

Marker.name: source
Marker.type: { name: string, title?: string, url?: string, snippet?: string }
Marker.description: What the marker points at; shown in the card on hover or focus (default: MARKER_SOURCE)

Marker.name: variant
Marker.description: Number shows `n` in mono, dot shows a small accent dot, name shows the source name (default: "number")

Marker.name: onOpen
Marker.description: Fires on click or Enter; the card stays a hover and focus preview

MediaGeneration.name: theme
MediaGeneration.description: Palette override. Defaults to the nearest ThemeProvider.

MediaGeneration.name: prompt
MediaGeneration.description: The prompt that produced the media, shown above the frame (default: MEDIAGEN_PROMPT)

MediaGeneration.name: status
MediaGeneration.description: Current state when autoplay is off (default: "generating")

MediaGeneration.name: progress
MediaGeneration.description: 0 to 100 while generating, when autoplay is off (default: 42)

MediaGeneration.name: etaSeconds
MediaGeneration.description: Seconds left, shown beside the progress bar (default: 9)

MediaGeneration.name: src
MediaGeneration.description: Image url once done; without one a neutral tile placeholder renders (default: undefined)

MediaGeneration.name: aspect
MediaGeneration.description: Frame proportion, kept in every state (default: "16:9")

MediaGeneration.name: variations
MediaGeneration.description: Number of frames shown when done (default: 1)

MediaGeneration.name: autoplay
MediaGeneration.description: Walks queued, generating and done on its own over `generateMs`; false renders `status` with no timers (default: true)

MediaGeneration.name: generateMs
MediaGeneration.description: Length of the generating phase in autoplay (default: 4200)

MediaGeneration.name: error
MediaGeneration.default: "The image service timed out. Nothing was charged."
MediaGeneration.description: Message shown in the failed state (default: "The image service timed out. Nothing was charged.")

MediaGeneration.name: onRegenerate
MediaGeneration.description: Fires from Regenerate and from Retry

MediaGeneration.name: onVariation
MediaGeneration.description: Fires when a variation frame is chosen

Message.name: theme
Message.description: Palette override. Defaults to the nearest ThemeProvider.

Message.name: role
Message.description: Who is speaking; sets alignment, bubble and default avatar (default: "agent")

Message.name: text
Message.description: The message as plain text (default: MSG_DEMO_TEXT); `children` replaces it with any content

Message.name: children
Message.description: Rich content for the turn; wins over `text`

Message.name: name
Message.description: Speaker name; shown above an agent turn, used for the user's default avatar

Message.name: time
Message.description: Timestamp label shown with the turn, for example "2:47 PM"

Message.name: avatar
Message.description: Replaces the default avatar; `null` hides it. Default is AgentGlyph for the agent and Avatar with the name for the user

Message.name: status
Message.description: Delivery state of a user turn; failed keeps the actions visible so Retry is reachable

Message.name: actions
Message.type: { label: string, icon?: node | "copy" | "retry" | "up" | "down" | "check" | "edit", onClick: () => void, active?: boolean }[]
Message.description: Quiet actions shown on hover and focus

Message.name: streaming
Message.description: Shows a caret at the end of the text while it arrives (default: false)

Message.name: sources
Message.description: Source chips under an agent turn

Message.name: compact
Message.description: Tighter spacing, smaller avatar and type (default: false)

QuestionCard.name: theme
QuestionCard.description: Palette override. Defaults to the nearest ThemeProvider.

QuestionCard.name: title
QuestionCard.description: Header line beside the agent mark (default: "Before Alpha continues")

QuestionCard.name: questions
QuestionCard.type: { id: string, question: string, context?: string, options: { id: string, label: string, sub?: string }[], allowOther?: boolean }[]

QuestionCard.name: skipLabel
QuestionCard.description: Ghost action that hands the decision back to the agent (default: "Skip, use defaults")

QuestionCard.name: doneLabel
QuestionCard.description: Primary action on the last question (default: "Continue")

QuestionCard.name: otherLabel
QuestionCard.description: Label of the free-text option when a question allows it (default: "Other")

QuestionCard.name: otherPlaceholder
QuestionCard.description: Placeholder of the free-text field (default: "Tell Alpha what you would prefer")

QuestionCard.name: skippedText
QuestionCard.default: "Skipped. Alpha will go with its defaults."
QuestionCard.description: Line shown after skipping (default: "Skipped. Alpha will go with its defaults.")

QuestionCard.name: onAnswer
QuestionCard.description: Fires when an option is picked; "other" for the free-text option

QuestionCard.name: onComplete
QuestionCard.type: (answers: Record<string, { optionId: string, label: string }>) => void
QuestionCard.description: Fires once with every answer when the last question is confirmed

QuestionCard.name: onSkip
QuestionCard.description: Fires when the user skips the remaining questions

ReasoningSteps.name: theme
ReasoningSteps.description: Palette override. Defaults to the nearest ThemeProvider.

ReasoningSteps.name: steps
ReasoningSteps.type: { id: string, kind: "thought" | "search" | "read" | "tool" | "write", label: string, detail?: string, durationMs?: number }[]
ReasoningSteps.description: Steps in order; each shows for its durationMs, or stepMs when absent (default: REASON_STEPS)

ReasoningSteps.name: autoplay
ReasoningSteps.description: Stream the steps in on mount; false renders the finished trace with no timers (default: true)

ReasoningSteps.name: stepMs
ReasoningSteps.description: Fallback duration for a step without durationMs (default: 900)

ReasoningSteps.name: summaryLabel
ReasoningSteps.description: Header text once done; a function receives the total seconds (default: `Thought for ${seconds} seconds`)

ReasoningSteps.name: collapsed
ReasoningSteps.description: Fold to the summary line once done; false leaves the steps open (default: true)

ReasoningSteps.name: collapseDelayMs
ReasoningSteps.description: Pause between the last step and the fold (default: 700)

ReasoningSteps.name: onDone
ReasoningSteps.description: Fires when the last step finishes (autoplay only)

ReasoningSteps.name: onToggle
ReasoningSteps.description: Fires when the trace opens or folds, by click or by the automatic fold

ResultCards.name: theme
ResultCards.description: Palette override. Defaults to the nearest ThemeProvider.

ResultCards.name: items
ResultCards.type: { id: string, title: string, subtitle?: string, meta?: string, badge?: string, image?: string | ReactNode, href?: string, actionLabel?: string, onAction?: (item) => void }[]
ResultCards.description: Cards to show; without an image a neutral placeholder tile renders (default: RESULT_ITEMS)

ResultCards.name: actionLabel

ResultCards.name: selectedLabel
ResultCards.description: Action label on the selected card (default: "Chosen")

ResultCards.name: onSelect
ResultCards.description: Fires when a card's title or action is activated; the card is also marked as selected

TaskList.name: theme
TaskList.description: Palette override. Defaults to the nearest ThemeProvider.

TaskList.name: tasks
TaskList.type: { id: string, label: string, status: "todo" | "running" | "done" | "failed" | "blocked", detail?: string }[]
TaskList.description: The job's tasks in order; copied into state on mount (default: TASKLIST_TASKS)

TaskList.name: autoplay
TaskList.description: Advance statuses on a timer: the running task finishes and the next to-do starts, until none are left (default: true)

TaskList.name: collapsible
TaskList.description: The header toggles the list; the count and bar stay visible (default: false)

TaskList.name: defaultOpen
TaskList.description: Initial list state when collapsible (default: true)

TaskList.name: retryLabel
TaskList.description: Label of the button on a failed task (default: "Retry")

TaskList.name: onChange
TaskList.description: Fires with the whole list whenever a status changes, by autoplay or retry

TaskList.name: onRetry
TaskList.description: Fires when a failed task's retry is pressed; the task is set to running

TaskList.name: onToggle
TaskList.description: Fires when a collapsible list opens or closes
